TITLE: Tomorrow's Blueprints (Poster)
TEXT:
Public consultation: Lantern & Fifth.
Bring compasses, spare maps, and at least one plausible excuse for altering the skyline.
Agenda: redistribute light, graft gardens onto rooftops, relocate the monument
whose statue keeps nodding off during ceremonies.
Attendance rewarded with a blueprint of an imaginary room where everyone knows your name.
